fields.territory_id: SberIndex internal identifier, joined exactly to frozen annual panel
fields.year: January-December observation year; source capture was in2026
fields.official_oktmo_8: same annual code verified on both input sides; retain leading zeros
fields.workers_total_source: published total101; people, not resident employment
fields.workers_total_frozen_core: previous core total, unchanged even when new total exists
fields.newly_available_workers_total: old total NULL and current source total available
fields.n_offered_sectors: number of non-total dimensions offered in source form, including U
fields.n_observed_sectors: number of non-total sections with observed numeric values
fields.n_valid_sector_shares: number of sections satisfying the individual ratio rules
fields.n_exceeds_total_sectors: number of individual observed numerators exceeding total
fields.observed_workers_sum_diagnostic: sum of observed section numerators only; no wages
fields.observed_sum_exceeds_official_total: nullable Boolean; NULL if ratio unavailable
fields.n_selected_shares_available: available share count among fixed A,B,C,D,H,O,P,Q
fields.selected8_complete: all eight shares available; not an eligibility override
fields.core_eligible: copied from frozen core, never recomputed from new source values
fields.conservative_eligible: copied from frozen core; includes original geography guards
fields.calendar_review: original core temporal review flag, not silently adjudicated here
fields.geography_status: original conditional linkage status, not legal boundary proof
fields.workers_total_source_*: SHA256, source CSV row and official request URL of denominator
fields.region_code,region_name,municipal_distri: unchanged descriptors from frozen core; never used for joins

long_table_statuses.valid: ratio satisfies rules; explicit source zero remains zero
long_table_statuses.not_offered: the section is absent from the source form
long_table_statuses.not_returned: no cell returned for an offered section; not a zero
long_table_statuses.unresolved_source_marker: source marker or blank could not be treated as numeric
long_table_statuses.invalid_total: observed numerator but denominator is missing, nonfinite or<=0
long_table_statuses.invalid_numerator: observed status but numeric cell is invalid; production audit rejects
long_table_statuses.exceeds_total: numerator>official total; ratio excluded without clipping
